excerpt.zh: [officer.GetName]在操作舰队方面变得更加灵敏了。
excerpt.en: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.

texts.zh: [officer.GetName]在操作舰队方面变得更加灵敏了。
texts.en: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.

texts.zh: [officer.GetName]更新了自身用于舰队管理的操作启发法。
texts.en: [officer.GetName] has updated its operational heuristics for fleet management.

texts.zh: 指挥官[officer.GetName]在探查[system.GetName]星系之后，[officer.GetHerHis]掌握了如何安排[officer.GetHerHis]的单位，以便最大化传感器的扫描范围。很少有舰队指挥官能够掌握如此复杂的操作。
texts.en: Following [officer.GetHerHis] recent sensor sweep of the [system.GetName] system, Commander [officer.GetName] has learned how to deploy [officer.GetHerHis] units to maximize their sensor range. Few fleet commanders possess the skill to carry out such complex maneuvers.
